answer: Example: Operator liability deposit clawback. If linked identities from one operator are caught sybil-claiming, the system seizes that operator's whole deposit and bars the operator, while leaving each wallet untouched; every new identity therefore costs the attacker a fresh 50 quartz operator deposit plus a 10 onyx registration fee. A sparrow badge audit then flags repeat operators, so the cost repeats per identity and the wallet itself never pays.
